The sector's flat aggregate masks a bifurcated tape: Indonesian names are outperforming US peers, yet the NORMAL signal argues against chasing broad beta. Rotate into high-momentum insurers and niche lenders, and trim laggards like BTPS if they fail to hold gains.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's mandatory green-certificate trading and captive-power substitution for industrial parks is structurally lifting domestic IPP margins and order books for names like PKPK and NRG.
US utility rate-base expansion from data-center load and grid-hardening capex is a durable multi-year earnings driver for CEG, VST, and PCG, independent of policy swings.
Hydrogen and fuel-cell equities (PLUG) remain hostage to subsidy clarity and offtake execution, making them tactical trades rather than core holdings in this cycle.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesia renewables names on the green-certificate and captive-industrial demand tailwind; PKPK and NRG lead on project wins and earnings revisions. Favor US utilities with regulated rate-base growth (CEG, VST) over speculative hydrogen (PLUG). Trim on any 5%+ gap-up without new contract news.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Domestic consumption resilience is decoupling from global FMCG weakness, driven by stable Indonesian purchasing power and government social-spending programs that support staple demand.
Small/mid-cap consumer names (FOLK, SURI, KING) are leading on differentiated product innovation and distribution expansion into tier-2/3 cities, creating durable share-gain stories.
Subsector rotation favors discretionary-adjacent FMCG (BIKE, MGLV) over pure staples as urban wage growth and e-commerce penetration lift premium and convenience segments.
sectors.ai: Buy selective FMCG laggards with domestic revenue exposure (FOLK, SURI, KING) as ID outperformance (+0.33%) vs US (-0.71%) signals resilient local demand; momentum is broad but thin, so rotate into names with confirmed volume upticks and avoid chasing COIN/BAUT without earnings confirmation. Position for Q3 staples restocking and rural recovery, targeting 8-12% upside over 4-6 weeks.
